name: OpenMausBot v0.1 AI Bot Team Chat
description: Chat with your own team of AI agents, each with its own model and tools.

PORT.description: Port of the public edge (Caddy) in front of OpenMausBot. Railway's healthcheck and the domain use it; keep 8080.

OPENMAUSBOT_OWNER_PASSWORD.description: Owner password for {your-domain}/railway/sign-in, generated at deploy (12+ characters). Signing in pairs that browser with full access. Empty turns the page off.

OMB_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public HTTPS address used in pairing and webhook links. Change it to https://{your-domain} after attaching a custom domain.

BOX_TOKEN.description: Optional. Boat (boat.dev) API key that gives bots their own cloud Linux computer (paid after Boat's trial). You can also paste it later in Settings.

COMPOSIO_API_KEY.description: Optional. Composio project key (ak_...) for connected apps such as Gmail, Slack or GitHub. You can also paste it later in Settings.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds a running deployment gets to stop bot turns cleanly before a redeploy replaces it.
